Tanzania invites EU investment in key sectors

DAILY NEWS Reporter1 day ago
648
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:02
Instaread

HELSINKI: THE Deputy Minister of State in the President’s Office for Planning and  Investment, Dr Pius Chaya, has invited investors from Finland and other European countries to  invest in Tanzania, highlighting opportunities in agriculture and agro-processing, manufacturing, mining and mineral value addition, energy, infrastructure, tourism, information and communication technology (ICT), and the digital  economy.

Investing

Discover more
History
investments
Geographic Reference

Dr Chaya made the remarks in Helsinki, Finland, while speaking at a preparatory meeting for the 2027 Tanzania–European Union Investment and Business Forum.

He said the objective was to turn investment discussions into concrete projects, production, employment opportunities, value addition and shared prosperity.

ALSO READ: EU investment boosts Tanzania’s agricultural exports through modern plant health systems

Dr Chaya said Tanzania, through the implementation of its Development Vision 2050, aims to build a competitive, inclusive and sustainable economy driven by investment, innovation and technology.

He also stressed that the government recognises the private sector as a key development partner and is welcoming investments that can support value addition, create jobs, facilitate technology transfer and connect Tanzania to international markets.
